    Subclasses of ClientRequest in org.adsl.shared.network.requests
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    ClientConnection
    Sent automatically when a client first establishes a connection to the server, before any login.
    class 
    ClientDisconnected
    Generated server-side when a client's connection is lost or closed (e.g. socket disconnect or RMI failure).
    class 
    ClientPing
    Sent periodically by the client as a heartbeat to let the server know it is still connected and responsive.
    class 
    CreateGameRequest
    Sent when a client wants to create a new game lobby with a given number of players.
    class 
    EnterGameRequest
    Sent when a client wants to join an existing game lobby identified by its id, for example one shown in a lobby list received via the home/lobby update flow.
    class 
    ExitGameRequest
    Sent when a client chooses to leave a game that is currently in progress (or has ended), returning the client to the home/lobby state.
    class 
    ExitLobbyRequest
    Sent when a client leaves the lobby of a game they have joined but that has not started yet, before StartGameRequest is sent.
    class 
    LoginRequest
    Sent when a client logs in with a chosen username, as part of the login flow handled by the server.
    class 
    LogoutRequest
    Sent when a logged-in client requests to log out, ending the session started by LoginRequest and returning the client to a logged-out state.
    class 
    MoveRequest
    Sent when a client performs one or more moves during their turn in an active game.
    class 
    StartGameRequest
    Sent by a client to start a game while still in its lobby, once enough players have joined.
    class 
    TotemPickingRequest
    Sent when a client picks their totem colour, typically during the game setup phase before play begins.
